observations: Photo 0 shows a single large rectangular solar panel with a grid of dark photovoltaic cells and a metal frame.
No visible brand/model label, watt rating, serial number, or sticker is readable in the photo.
No inverter, battery, charge controller, mounting hardware, or wiring is shown.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo shows only a solar panel, but no system components or solution details.

risks.risk: Panel wattage (power rating) is unknown; price depends heavily on Wp (e.g., 100W vs 550W).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing Wp rating, model, and serial number (usually on the back or edge frame).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest plausible value for a used generic panel of unknown rating (worst-case: treat as low-power and not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Condition/health is unknown (possible cracks, micro-cracks, delamination, or reduced output).
risks.proof: Photos of the panel surface from multiple angles plus a working test: IV curve or at least a power output reading under sun/with a tester.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/possibly degraded (worst-case: treat as reduced output).

risks.risk: Compatibility and completeness are unknown (panel may be sold alone; buyer may need controller/inverter/battery).
risks.proof: Confirm exactly what is included in the sale (panel only vs full solar kit) with a photo of all items and quantities.

risks.risk: Electrical safety/connection integrity is unknown (junction box condition, cable condition, connectors).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the junction box and connectors/cables; show any damage and confirm polarity/MC4 type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring inspection/possible replacement of cables/connectors (worst-case: treat as needing minor repairs).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the panel label showing brand, model, serial number, and watt rating (Wp).
Photos of the back/edge frame and junction box (including cable/connector type).
A test result showing actual output (or IV curve) and whether it was recently used/installed.
response.reason: The photo confirms a solar panel exists, but the key pricing driver (brand/model and watt rating) is not readable, so a worst-case price cannot be set confidently without the label details.
